title: Halt hunts ranked by expected hits; the segmented Coq replay as a tool
text: The segmented Coq replay that proved the halt of 1RB1LC_1LC1RD_1LA0LB_0RB1RE_1RF0RA_---0RC is now a generator (tools/segreplay): from a visit map written as a list of cases it produces the Coq checker, its correctness proof and the segments, for eight machines so far with no hand work. A perturbation probe on the same maps estimates the expected number of halts per doubling of the run. It gives 0.034 for the machine that halted (about 1.2 expected hits when it did). 1RB1RF_0LC0RF_1RD1LC_---0LE_0RC1LF_1RA0LE and 1RB0RC_1LC1RE_1RA1LD_0LC0LA_1RF1RD_---0RD are in the same regime (0.056 and 0.045) and have each passed about 3 expected hits without halting; five other machines are a hundred times lower and not worth hunting.
